{{short description|Danish stereology researcher}}
'''Hans Jørgen Gottlieb Gundersen''' (2 May 1943 – 1 February 2021) was a Danish [[stereology]] researcher. He was employed as a [[professor]] at [[Aarhus University]].

In January 2008 he received the [[August Krogh Prize]] "for his ground-breaking research in stereology for the spatial description and understanding of biological tissue".<ref>{{Cite web|date=2008-03-01|title=Annual Report from the Board|url=http://www.novonordiskfonden.dk/en/annualreport.asp|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20081025150800/http://www.novonordiskfonden.dk/en/annualreport.asp|archivedate=2008-10-25|publisher=[[Novonordiskfonden]]|language=en}}</ref> He was also a recipient of the [[Novo Nordisk]] Prize.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Jørgen Kjems|url=http://www.novonordiskfonden.dk/en/content/novo-nordisk-prize|access-date=2014-08-24|archive-date=2013-11-07|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131107174157/http://www.novonordiskfonden.dk/en/content/novo-nordisk-prize|url-status=dead}}</ref>
